name: Kabwata Cultural Village
subtitle: A craft and arts village in Lusaka where artisans from Zambia's provinces display and sell work.

parts.text: A craft and arts village in Lusaka where artisans from Zambia's provinces display and sell work. It began in 1974 as a government idea to bring the country's cultures together.
